model.plane: X-Z, Z up; every out-of-plane displacement (UY, RX, RZ), reaction (FY, MX, MZ) and end action is exactly 0

supports.one-way S: UZ, sense + (bears upward only); ground at u_z = 0; no imposed movement
supports.friction S: UX, coefficient mu; normal = the reaction of 'one-way S' (its normal reaction source)

section.basis: nominal and reduced bases coincide (zero allowance and tolerance), so the stiffness is the same on either

model.pressure: none: the models carry no pressure; the friction law does not depend on it
model.self_weight: none; every load is a nodal force listed per case

conventions.reaction: support-on-pipe force (K u - f) at the support's degree of freedom, global axes
conventions.N: the one-way support's reaction FZ while it is active; 0 while it is inactive
conventions.states: one-way: active | inactive; friction: inactive | stick | slide+ | slide- (slide sign = sign of u_x(S))
conventions.end action: force or moment the node exerts on the member at that end, global axes; MY about +Y (Z toward X positive)
conventions.displacement exact form: rational / pi; reactions and end actions are rational (pi cancels)
conventions.value: nearest binary64 of the exact value

tolerance_class: DEL-04-07/AC-002 and DEL-04-04/AC-001: support states must equal these exactly; displacements and reactions agree within the nonlinear tolerance of their class (the governed per-class record, DEL-09-03/REQ-007). This package chooses no number.
